messages:
tara: Starting canary for quantum7b-int4 on dedicated. Seeing progressive fragmentation and one OOM at ~22m when batch >= 7. KV alloc spikes in logs.

vik: Paste config? especially prefetch, async flags, max_new_tokens.

tara: Config used:
```
model: quantum7b-int4
batch_size: 7
max_new_tokens: 320
prefetch: 3
async_prefetch: true
soft_reserve: 0.1
slot_compaction: background
```

leo: Quick hypothesis: async_prefetch + int4 increases many transient KV buffers; with batch=7 freelist fragmentation increases and compactor can't keep up. Try batch=5 and prefetch=1. Also cap max_new_tokens to 128 for canary.

tara: Spun two smokes: A) batch=5, prefetch=1, max_new_tokens=128; B) batch=7, slot_compactor.aggr=high, kv_trim_interval=4s.

ops-bot: deploy job #8234 started: canary-quantum7b-int4 -> pool-dedicated-02.

tara: After 18m run-A stable, fragmentation flatten ~57%, no OOMs. Run-B still hit an OOM at 20m but slope slower. Latency tradeoff small (+7% p99).

vik: Sounds like safe defaults: batch=5, prefetch=1, max_new_tokens=128 for int4 7b family. Also add metric kv_eviction_rate and alert when >15/min for >5m. Consider auto-fallback to int8 if eviction spikes.

leo: For quality: schedule 100-run eval on long prompts >=512 tokens; fail gate if log-likelihood delta >1% or repeat-rate increases. If quality breaks, try mixed-precision (kv int8).

tara: I'll open PR with defaults + alert + fallback policy and include perf runs. Action items: tara PR, leo eval, vik compactor patch.

ops-bot: deploy job #8234 success: canary stable at 30m.

tara: Closing thread for now. Will link PR + eval artifacts when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
